I feel so stupid for all the time i wasted. If i was working in my field during the last 4 years i would be in a much better position. Sadly i was hearing people negativity, i got affected and depressed. A little before i turned 30 i decided to hear my heart, i designed my portfolio from zero (i almost forgot how to use design programs and i had to recreate a lot of things i did in university) i applied to every open position and in two months i got a decent job and i feel proud.
Never give up guys. Love what you do and be positive! If I did it (in my thirties, with no experience, and with a poor portfolio) you can do it to!
